published_failure_contract: Spring Boot 2.6 disables circular bean references by default. Spring Shell 2.0.1 ResultHandlerConfig contains a self-reference reached through the sshShellSessionManager, sshShellCommandFactory, and sshShell bean graph, so all three client modules fail while creating the application context.

source_isolation.evidence: Spring Boot commit 01e741d7039b626054911e0797872776ce28c120, an ancestor of v2.6.0 but not v2.5.3, sets allowCircularReferences to false by default and exposes spring.main.allow-circular-references as an escape setting.

a1_input.evidence: The FSE package records three executions of the 2.5.3 to 2.6.0 replacement but omits the exact target revision. Target PR 167 independently changes only spring-boot.version from 2.5.6 to 2.6.0, but it was never merged and contains no repair.

target_history.evidence: All 947 commits reachable from remote refs and 722 unique POM blobs were inspected. The only 2.6.0 POM is unmerged PR 167. Main never adopted a 2.6.x release or spring.main.allow-circular-references. PR 230 later combines Boot 2.7.2, Spring Shell 2.1.0, and a broad rewrite, so it cannot recover an exact A2 under the fixed 2.6.0 source input.

stop_reason: The source mechanism and historical A1 lead are strong, but the target history contains no maintainer-authored recovery for the fixed Spring Boot 2.6.0 input. The later multi-dependency migration is not an exact A2.
